topics.angle: The forgotten people behind inventions we use every day - especially scholars of the Islamic Golden Age, China, India - told as adventure stories. Hook with a concrete vivid question in the first 10 s -> 5-7 beats, each a mini-story with a visual mechanism -> twist -> short recap. Never dry lists.
